info.title: GARANG Commercial API
info.description: Server boundary for GARANG contract garang-state-v1 / schema v8. AI responses use garang-ai-v1 and mutation tools use garang-tools-v1. Provider-specific adapters must translate at the edge without changing GARANG state semantics.

200.description: Service health including data, AI and tool contract versions
Saved idempotently after top-level domain type validation

post.description: Accepts local data only when contractVersion is garang-state-v1 and schemaVersion is supported.

200.description: Migration accepted with canonical contract acknowledgement
User data export with contractVersion and schemaVersion

post.description: Provider-neutral GARANG Coach response endpoint. The current development adapter is Mock AI. Tool calls are validated and converted to pending actions; they never mutate user state before explicit confirmation.

200.description: AI text plus zero or more pending actions

post.description: Creates a validated pending GARANG action. Allowed tools: createPlan, updatePlan, saveMemory, deleteRecord, updateGoal.
Explicitly confirms or rejects one user-owned pending action. A confirmed action is applied to canonical user state and returns the execution result.

404.description: Action not found for this user
